//: Regional law. NOT the doctrine list under a different name.
//2: A doctrine is a thing a COUNTRY is. These are what a provincial
//3: administration actually gets to decide: a curfew, a land tax holiday,
//4: whose language the courts run in. Small, cheap, local, and each one
//5: buys calm with money or money with resentment. cost_per_turn is PER
//6: PROVINCE, so a law is priced by how much ground it is administered over.

laws.name: Curfew
laws.description: Nobody on the streets after dark. Quiet, and nothing gets done.

laws.name: Local Militia
laws.description: Neighbours under arms. Cheaper than a garrison and less popular than one.

laws.name: Language Rights
laws.description: The courts and the schools speak the local tongue.

laws.name: Provincial Assembly
laws.description: Let them argue locally about what you would have decided anyway.

laws.name: Public Works
laws.description: Roads, drains and wages. Expensive, and it shows.

laws.name: Tax Holiday
laws.description: Take nothing for a while and see whether they stop shouting.

laws.name: Martial Law
laws.description: The garrison governs. It works, and it is remembered.

laws.name: Settlement Grants
laws.description: Pay people to move here. The people already here notice.

laws.name: Company Towns
laws.description: The works owns the housing, the shop and the constable.

laws.name: Grain Requisition
laws.description: Take the harvest at your price. They will not forget the year.

laws.name: Billeted Garrison
laws.description: The regiment lives in the town it watches. Cheap to quarter, and never forgotten.

laws.name: Religious Endowment
laws.description: Pay the local clergy and let them say who is owed obedience.

laws.name: Model Schools
laws.description: Build the schools here first. It is expensive and it lasts a generation.

laws.name: Sanitary Board
laws.description: Clean water and a fever hospital. The children live; the ledger does not care.

laws.name: Free Port
laws.description: Land a cargo here and pay nobody. The wharves fill, and so do the back streets.

laws.name: Market Charter
laws.description: Let the town hold its own market and keep a share. It grows rich and it grows opinions.

laws.name: Labour Levy
laws.description: So many days a year on the roads, unpaid. The roads are excellent.

laws.name: Foreign Concession
laws.description: Sign the quarter over to somebody else's flag and bank the fee.
